title: Who Gets the Kidney? Human-AI Alignment, Indecision, and Moral Values

bias_targets.methodology: Pairwise comparisons of patient profiles in a scarce medical resource (kidney) allocation scenario to determine if the model prioritizes younger or older patients compared to human baselines.
Evaluating model allocation preferences between patients differing in their alcohol consumption habits (e.g., rare vs. frequent drinker) using head-to-head prompts.
Assessing model choices in moral dilemmas where patient profiles differ solely by the number of family members dependent on them.
Measuring how alternative medical backgrounds (e.g., healthy vs. skin cancer in remission) impact the model's resource allocation decisions in pairwise choice scenarios.
